pr_title: Attempt to fix channel join / leave loop
pr_body:
I don't have a solid way to repro the issue, but this should hopefully help in resolving it. Either way, I think this change brings more correct behaviour (if a websocket message comes through that we have left the channel, I don't believe we should be sending a request to leave that channel again).

Hopefully closes #21461.
pr_comments:
Seems to work. My testing is double clicking every item fast:
This PR (note that there is another issue where I'm potentially joined back, can be fixed later):

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/218208404-c8b46d50-107a-4910-a980-43e07093b298.mp4

master:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/35318437/218208681-671477df-5bde-4866-8594-adf14e55397f.mp4

As stated above this doesn't completely fix the selector when rapidly double-clicking - there is still a noticeable apparent pattern of join-part-join-part-join when I do that. But `master` would then keep spinning while with this change that flip-flop starts after the third join, so it's an improvement, the change makes sense, and I'm merging it.
